source.excerpt: Structured education programs are effective in improving glycemic control and multiple cardiometabolic risk factors in patients with T2D. These findings strongly support the integration of standardized patient education as a core component of comprehensive T2D management in clinical practice and guideline recommendations.

cards.headline: Will AI Replace Physicians in the Near Future? AI Adoption Barriers in Medicine

source.title: Will AI Replace Physicians in the Near Future? AI Adoption Barriers in Medicine.
source.excerpt: In the foreseeable future, AI will augment rather than replace physicians. The most realistic trajectory involves automation of well-defined tasks under human supervision, while clinical integration, physical examination, procedural performance, ethical judgment, and accountability remain physician-dependent.

cards.headline: Security of Deep Research Agents

source.title: Security of Deep Research Agents: Attack Surface, Defenses, Benchmarks, and Agenda Seeding against Research Planning
source.excerpt: Injection detection and query anchoring fail against it, verification prompting hurts utility, and our proposed provenance tagging preserves utility but can be bypassed by multi-site bait. Finally, we propose eight research directions.

cards.headline: AI-Based Clinical Decision Support Systems in Primary Care

source.title: AI-Based Clinical Decision Support Systems in Primary Care: Systematic Review of Clinical Implementation.
source.excerpt: AI-CDSSs in primary care may provide more consistent benefits for workflow-related and process-level outcomes in structured and protocolized decision contexts, while evidence on safety remains insufficient to support confident routine implementation.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Emergency Medicine

source.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Emergency Medicine: Balancing Opportunities and Challenges.
source.excerpt: Ultimately, AI holds enormous promise for improving patient care and resource management in emergency medicine; however, ensuring safety, fairness, and accountability remains vital.

cards.headline: A Dataset for Misogyny Detection in Polish Social Media

source.title: A Dataset for Misogyny Detection in Polish Social Media: Transferability of Hateful Speech Detection from General to Specific Types of Hate
source.excerpt: The study contributes a new Polish resource for gender-directed harmful language and demonstrates that the scope and granularity of prior safety training are important factors in transferring harmful language detection from general to specific forms of hate.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence at the gut-oral microbiota frontier

source.title: Artificial intelligence at the gut-oral microbiota frontier: mapping machine learning tools for gastric cancer risk prediction.
source.excerpt: AI-based microbiome models, including non-invasive diagnostics, show high potential for gastric cancer prediction. Yet, reproducibility, external validation, and reporting transparency remain critical barriers to clinical implementation. Standardized pipelines, multi-omics integration, and prospective validation are needed to transition this field from proof-of-concept to precision oncology.

cards.headline: Novel Technologies for Gastrointestinal Cancer Detection

source.title: Novel Technologies for Gastrointestinal Cancer Detection: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Diagnostic Accuracy.
source.excerpt: Clinicians and policy makers must weigh the added value of novel technologies against current practice, regulatory requirements, clinical understanding, interpretation of results, and public trust.

cards.headline: Latent Lattice Language Models

source.title: Latent Lattice Language Models
source.excerpt: These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.

cards.headline: The application of ChatGPT in nursing: a bibliometric and visualized analysis

source.title: The application of ChatGPT in nursing: a bibliometric and visualized analysis.
source.excerpt: ChatGPT is an emerging tool in the nursing field, currently in the foundational research phase. While there is significant international collaboration, cooperation among author groups remains somewhat limited. Studies focusing on ChatGPT in nursing primarily concentrate on two key themes: (1) the deep learning of ChatGPT in nursing and (2) the feasibility of its application.

cards.headline: Aber nein!

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:76
source.excerpt: ليس الأمر كما زعم هؤلاء الكاذبون، فإن المتقي حقاً هو من أوفى بما عاهد الله عليه من أداء الأمانة والإيمان به وبرسله والتزم هديه وشرعه، وخاف الله عز وجل فامتثل أمره وانتهى عما نهى عنه. والله يحب المتقين الذين يتقون الشرك والمعاصي.

cards.arabic: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِۦ وَٱتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
cards.translation: Aber nein! Wer seinen Bund hält und gottesfürchtig ist, - gewiß, Allah liebt die Gottes fürchtigen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: How Trustworthy Are the Jews: Allah states that there are deceitful people among the Jews.

cards.headline: Diejenigen, die ihren Bund mit Allah und ihre Eide für einen geringen Preis verkaufen …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:77
source.excerpt: إن الذين يستبدلون بعهد الله ووصيته التي أوصى بها في الكتب التي أنزلها على أنبيانهم، عوضًا وبدلا خسيسًا من عرض الدنيا وحطامها، أولئك لا نصيب لهم من الثواب في الآخرة، ولا يكلمهم الله بما يسرهم، ولا ينظر إليهم يوم القيامة بعين الرحمة، ولا يطهرهم من دنس الذنوب والكفر، ولهم عذاب موجع.

cards.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَـٰقَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
cards.translation: Diejenigen, die ihren Bund mit Allah und ihre Eide für einen geringen Preis verkaufen, haben am Jenseits keinen Anteil. Und Allah wird am Tag der Auferstehung weder zu ihnen sprechen noch sie anschauen noch sie läutern. Für sie wird es schmerzhafte Strafe geben.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
